sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="960" height="640" viewBox="0 0 960 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">An anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles</title>
  <desc id="desc">A cheerful cartoon anteater with a long snout and bushy tail pedals a teal unicycle while three colourful bottles loop through the air above its paws.</desc>

  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8ed8ff"/>
      <stop offset="0.62" stop-color="#dff7ff"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#fff3c9"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="fur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#c99a68"/>
      <stop offset="0.58" stop-color="#a97448"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7c4f2e"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="furDark" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8a5a34"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#54341d"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="glassGreen" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9ff0b3"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#2fbf71"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#087f4f"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="glassBlue" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#aee9ff"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#38a8e8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1769aa"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="glassAmber" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe49a"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#ffb02e"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c66a00"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <clipPath id="bodyClip">
      <ellipse cx="475" cy="272" rx="102" ry="59" transform="rotate(-5 475 272)"/>
    </clipPath>

    <!-- One bottle, centred on (0,0) so it can spin while travelling. -->
    <g id="bottleShape">
      <path d="M -6 -27 L 6 -27 L 6 -13 C 6 -7 15 -4 15 5 L 15 22 C 15 30 11 34 4 34 L -4 34 C -11 34 -15 30 -15 22 L -15 5 C -15 -4 -6 -7 -6 -13 Z"/>
      <rect x="-8" y="-33" width="16" height="8" rx="3"/>
      <rect x="-10" y="-1" width="20" height="17" rx="3" fill="#fff8dc" opacity="0.92"/>
      <path d="M -8 -8 C -11 3 -11 16 -9 27" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.55"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="7" r="3.2" fill="#e94f37"/>
    </g>

    <path id="jugglePath" d="M 398 208 C 420 62 592 62 614 208 C 594 274 418 274 398 208 Z"/>

    <style><![CDATA[
      .wheel-spin {
        transform-origin: 480px 432px;
        animation: spin 1.05s linear infinite;
      }
      .sun-rays {
        transform-origin: 118px 104px;
        animation: spin 24s linear infinite;
      }
      .rider-bob {
        animation: bob 0.55s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .tail-wag {
        transform-origin: 386px 282px;
        animation: tail 1.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .head-bob {
        transform-origin: 570px 232px;
        animation: head 1.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .ear-wiggle {
        transform-origin: 552px 196px;
        animation: ear 0.9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .leg-a {
        transform-origin: 452px 318px;
        animation: pedal-a 1.05s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
      .leg-b {
        transform-origin: 505px 316px;
        animation: pedal-b 1.05s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
      .arm-a {
        transform-origin: 536px 274px;
        animation: juggle-a 0.7s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .arm-b {
        transform-origin: 552px 282px;
        animation: juggle-b 0.7s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .bottle-spin-a { animation: spin 0.68s linear infinite; }
      .bottle-spin-b { animation: spin-rev 0.78s linear infinite; }
      .bottle-spin-c { animation: spin 0.58s linear infinite; }
      .cloud-a { animation: drift-a 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
      .cloud-b { animation: drift-b 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
      .ground-lines { animation: ground 0.65s linear infinite; }
      .shadow-pulse { animation: shadow 0.55s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: 480px 526px; }
      .tongue {
        transform-origin: 704px 254px;
        animation: tongue 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
      .dust-a { animation: dust-a 0.9s ease-out infinite; }
      .dust-b { animation: dust-b 0.9s ease-out 0.3s infinite; }
      .dust-c { animation: dust-a 0.9s ease-out 0.6s infinite; }
      .sparkle { animation: sparkle 1.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
      .sparkle-late { animation: sparkle 1.4s ease-in-out 0.55s infinite alternate; }

      @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
      @keyframes spin-rev { to { transform: rotate(-360deg); } }
      @keyframes bob {
        from { transform: translateY(3px); }
        to   { transform: translateY(-5px); }
      }
      @keyframes tail {
        from { transform: rotate(-4deg); }
        to   { transform: rotate(5deg); }
      }
      @keyframes head {
        from { transform: rotate(-2deg) translateY(1px); }
        to   { transform: rotate(2.5deg) translateY(-2px); }
      }
      @keyframes ear {
        from { transform: rotate(-7deg); }
        to   { transform: rotate(8deg); }
      }
      @keyframes pedal-a {
        0%, 100% { transform: rotate(19deg); }
        50%      { transform: rotate(-21deg); }
      }
      @keyframes pedal-b {
        0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-21deg); }
        50%      { transform: rotate(19deg); }
      }
      @keyframes juggle-a {
        from { transform: rotate(4deg) translateY(3px); }
        to   { transform: rotate(-5deg) translateY(-5px); }
      }
      @keyframes juggle-b {
        from { transform: rotate(-5deg) translateY(-4px); }
        to   { transform: rotate(4deg) translateY(4px); }
      }
      @keyframes drift-a {
        from { transform: translateX(-18px); }
        to   { transform: translateX(34px); }
      }
      @keyframes drift-b {
        from { transform: translateX(26px); }
        to   { transform: translateX(-24px); }
      }
      @keyframes ground {
        from { transform: translateX(0); }
        to   { transform: translateX(-92px); }
      }
      @keyframes shadow {
        from { transform: scaleX(1); opacity: 0.20; }
        to   { transform: scaleX(0.9); opacity: 0.14; }
      }
      @keyframes tongue {
        0%, 68%, 100% { transform: scaleX(0.18); opacity: 0; }
        76%, 86%      { transform: scaleX(1); opacity: 1; }
      }
      @keyframes dust-a {
        0%   { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(0.55); opacity: 0; }
        25%  { opacity: 0.55; }
        100% { transform: translate(-62px, -22px) scale(1.45); opacity: 0; }
      }
      @keyframes dust-b {
        0%   { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(0.5); opacity: 0; }
        25%  { opacity: 0.45; }
        100% { transform: translate(-78px, -10px) scale(1.25); opacity: 0; }
      }
      @keyframes sparkle {
        from { transform: scale(0.55) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0.25; }
        to   { transform: scale(1.15) rotate(28deg); opacity: 1; }
      }

      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        * { animation: none !important; }
      }
    ]]></style>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sky -->
  <rect width="960" height="640" fill="url(#sky)"/>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <g>
    <g class="sun-rays" stroke="#ffc93c" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.85">
      <line x1="118" y1="24" x2="118" y2="48"/>
      <line x1="118" y1="160" x2="118" y2="184"/>
      <line x1="38" y1="104" x2="62" y2="104"/>
      <line x1="174" y1="104" x2="198" y2="104"/>
      <line x1="62" y1="48" x2="79" y2="65"/>
      <line x1="157" y1="143" x2="174" y2="160"/>
      <line x1="174" y1="48" x2="157" y2="65"/>
      <line x1="79" y1="143" x2="62" y2="160"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="118" cy="104" r="46" fill="#ffd93d" stroke="#ffae00" stroke-width="5"/>
    <circle cx="104" cy="94" r="6" fill="#5d4037"/>
    <circle cx="134" cy="94" r="6" fill="#5d4037"/>
    <path d="M 100 116 Q 118 130 136 116" fill="none" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Clouds -->
  <g class="cloud-a" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.94">
    <ellipse cx="330" cy="88" rx="58" ry="24"/>
    <ellipse cx="368" cy="72" rx="44" ry="28"/>
    <ellipse cx="292" cy="72" rx="34" ry="20"/>
  </g>
  <g class="cloud-b" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.88">
    <ellipse cx="766" cy="128" rx="68" ry="25"/>
    <ellipse cx="810" cy="108" rx="46" ry="30"/>
    <ellipse cx="724" cy="110" rx="36" ry="21"/>
  </g>
  <g class="cloud-a" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.65">
    <ellipse cx="646" cy="58" rx="42" ry="17"/>
    <ellipse cx="674" cy="46" rx="30" ry="19"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Distant hills and trees -->
  <path d="M 0 470 Q 150 382 330 458 T 680 442 T 960 452 L 960 530 L 0 530 Z" fill="#8ed081"/>
  <path d="M 0 492 Q 190 424 410 482 T 960 478 L 960 535 L 0 535 Z" fill="#5cb85c"/>
  <g stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="86" y1="474" x2="86" y2="438"/>
    <line x1="874" y1="478" x2="874" y2="440"/>
    <line x1="716" y1="470" x2="716" y2="442"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#2e9e4f">
